title: Meet TradingView
goal: Learn what TradingView is and that it is free.

objectives.text: Know that an account is free.
Know you can skip the sign up.

slides.text: TradingView is a website with charts. It has a phone app too. Traders all over the world use it.
slides.title: A chart website

slides.text: You can join for free. The free plan has ads and some limits. Some prices may show up late.
slides.title: Free to join

slides.text: Tap Sign up to join. Use an email you own. Make the password long and hard to guess.
slides.title: Making an account

slides.text: Never share your password. Candlo will not ask for it. Beware of sites that ask for it.
slides.title: Keep it secret

slides.text: Candlo does not need TradingView. Our Chart Lab has the same tools. You can learn here and never sign up.
slides.title: Candlo is on its own

questions.explanation: TradingView is a website and app with charts.

questions.prompt: You must pay to join TradingView.
questions.explanation: No. The free plan costs nothing. It has ads and limits.

questions.prompt: What comes with the free plan?
questions.explanation: The free plan costs nothing. It has ads and some limits.

questions.prompt: It is fine to tell a friend your password.
questions.explanation: No. Keep it secret. Only you should know it.

questions.prompt: A site asks for your password. What do you do?
questions.explanation: Never share it. Candlo will not ask for it.
No. Candlo works on its own. You never have to sign up.

questions.prompt: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: TradingView is the chart site. The free plan has limits. A password stays secret.
